originalTitle: Facebook Pages require paid subscription to post more than two links per month
content: Attached: 1 image Facebook achieving absurd new heights of enshittification by now charging a subscription of at least $50/mo to... post more than two links a month to your own Facebook page. Covers comments too. Subscription not even available in UK yet. Don't know why we bother with them. Their documentation about this: https://www.facebook.com/help/1929252614431792
chineseTitle: Facebook 页面需要付费订阅才能每月发布两个以上链接
chineseContent: 附：1 张图片 Facebook 现在收取至少 50 美元/月的订阅费用，从而达到了荒谬的 enshittiification 新高度……每月向您自己的 Facebook 页面发布两个以上链接。也涵盖评论。在英国甚至还无法订阅。不知道我们为什么要打扰他们。他们关于此的文档：https://www.facebook.com/help/1929252614431792
